title: Moon Seal — payload
description: A closed moon's rows of the shared stars chain, sealed as a scroll: exactly the stars Worker's GET /scroll?moon= output, with sealed fixed to true. The response is Mages City's acknowledgement carrying the root it re-derived.

sealed.description: Only a closed moon is sealed.

stars.description: The number of rows, egg/find rows included.

marks.description: The number of distinct marks among the rows.

root.description: Fold of sha256(root + "|" + hash) from 64 zeros over the rows' hashes in chain order.

rule.description: OPTIONAL. Names the fold rule: `linkFoldV1` is root = sha256(root + "|" + hash), from 64 zeros, over this moon's links in chain order (the Worker states it in words).

rows.description: Every row of the moon, in chain order. At most 38,000 rows, the count the 16 MiB maxDocumentBytes holds at about 430 bytes per row.

seq.description: The row's sequence number on the stars chain, from 0, strictly increasing in chain order.

type.description: The star type (a deliberate star, or egg/find).

place.description: The first path segment of the page, or empty when the star carried none.

Hex256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.

MoonId.description: A moon: moon-YYYY-MM-DD, the UTC date of its new moon.

root.description: The root Mages City re-derived from the rows.

scrollRef.description: OPTIONAL. Where the City publishes the scroll.
